## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …)
- [ ] All commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, see [DCO](https://developercertificate.org))
- [ ] Targets `dev` (or `main` for `hotfix/*`)
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings`, `cargo test` pass locally
- [ ] Docs / SPEC / ADR updated if behaviour or architecture changed
